newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Student find goes down a bomb in Irish classroom.
newsitem.headline: Student find goes down a bomb in Irish classroom.

text.p: An Irish geography teacher who encouraged students to bring geological items into class got a shock when one pupil turned up with a rusty grenade.

Students had to be evacuated from the secondary school in Castledermot, County Kildare, on Wednesday after the police and army were called in to deal with the World War One vintage Mills grenade, found in a local field.
"It was safe but there was no way of knowing that until it was examined. It was just a shell of a grenade," an army spokesman said.
